history.summary: A freehold 507 sqft 1BR at VA Residences (D12, 2016) for $850k / $1,676 psf, with modest 2.64%/yr URA appreciation over a thin 19-txn base and a poor 1.32km MRT walk. Freehold and a low ticket are the only real positives against weak momentum and a far-from-transit boutique location.
history.rating_rationale: Weak Elo (607, 47-260 record) and score_1000 461 reflect the negatives: 2.64%/yr resale CAGR is sub-RCR over only 19 txns, the 1.32km/16-min MRT walk hurts rental and resale, and a 507 sqft shoebox is a niche exit. Freehold tenure and a sub-$900k entry keep it liquid for cash buyers. PSF sits right at median, so it's fairly priced but not compelling.
